_comment: Hand-written store release notes for 10.3.3, in both listing languages. tool/gen_changelog.py prefers this file over anything it can derive from the commits, then runs it through the same per-store platform gate as every other source — so keep every line free of operating-system, device and store names. One line per bullet; the leading bullet character is added when the note is written. Keep it short: the Play note is capped at 480 characters including the bullets.
en: The new-item button is honey gold again in dark mode, and keeps its colour while you press it
de: Der Neu-Knopf ist im dunklen Modus wieder honiggolden und behält seine Farbe, während man ihn drückt
